original.target_description: Shiner, Masten, and Tellegen (2002), single longitudinal cohort; Table 4, adult MPQ Constraint correlated with concurrent age-20 Conduct (rule-abiding versus antisocial conduct), complete-case participants. This is a located candidate; the supplied locator does not uniquely distinguish childhood from concurrent conduct.

n.sample_role: Participants with complete childhood adaptation, adult adaptation, and adult personality data; analytic subsample for Table 4 correlations.
n.exclusions: Complete-case restriction explicitly stated. Initial cohort 205; specific exclusion reasons beyond incomplete data are not enumerated for this test.
n.location: p. 1171 (PDF p. 7), section “Is Personality in Emerging Adulthood Related to Childhood and Concurrent Adaptation?”, paragraph preceding Table 4
n.quote: These analyses were conducted with a subsample of 187 participants for whom the childhood adaptation data and the adult adaptation and personality data were complete.

es.location: p. 1171 (PDF p. 7), Table 4, Constraint row × Concurrent adaptation / Conduct column

p.location: p. 1171 (PDF p. 7), Table 4, Constraint row × Concurrent adaptation / Conduct column; three-asterisk table footnote

notes: Published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service; title, authors, year and DOI verified in supplied text. Only original target examined. Statistics are printed correlations with positively scored rule-abiding conduct, not sign-converted correlations with antisocial behavior. Page 1170 states: “the conduct composite was scored in the opposite direction (ranging from poor to good conduct)”. The p value and r refer to the same concurrent Conduct cell. Target match remains unknown because the neutral description and p.7 locator do not explicitly select concurrent versus childhood conduct. The selected candidate is the higher-order MPQ Constraint scale: p.1166 says “This higher order trait is most related to the Big Five Conscientiousness trait”. The paper also identifies lower-order Control as similar to Big Five Conscientiousness (p.1172); Table 4 prints Control/concurrent Conduct .27***, Constraint/childhood Conduct .23**, and Control/childhood Conduct .21**. The supplied locator does not uniquely select Constraint rather than Control. No alternative cells are merged into the extracted candidate.
